subject: science
name: Science
course: Energy Transfers, Waves, Earth's Changing Surface & Organism Structures
title: Grade 4 Science: Energy Transfers, Waves, Earth's Changing Surface & Organism Structures
overview: Grade 4 Science engages students in the scientific method and engineering design process across physical, life, and Earth/space sciences aligned with Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS).
competencies: Ask scientific questions, plan and conduct controlled investigations, and analyze experimental data.
Develop and use models to describe natural systems, energy flows, and physical interactions.
Construct explanations supported by empirical evidence and scientific reasoning.
Design, test, and optimize engineering solutions to real-world technological and environmental problems.

modules.title: Energy: Collisions, Circuits & Renewable Power
modules.description: Investigating how speed relates to energy, how energy transfers in collisions, electrical circuits, and clean energy solutions.

topics.title: Kinetic Energy and Collisions
topics.description: Measuring how increasing speed increases the energy transferred during impact collisions.

topics.title: Electrical Circuits and Energy Conversion
topics.description: Constructing complete circuits and investigating how electricity converts to light, sound, heat, and motion.

topics.title: Renewable and Non-Renewable Natural Resources
topics.description: Evaluating solar, wind, hydroelectric, and fossil fuel energy impacts on the environment.

modules.title: Waves, Light Reflections & Information Transfer
modules.description: Modeling wavelength and amplitude in water waves, exploring how light enters the eye to allow sight, and binary signaling.

topics.title: Wave Properties: Amplitude and Wavelength
topics.description: Using models to demonstrate how waves transfer energy through matter without moving the matter itself.

topics.title: Light Reflection and Vision
topics.description: Investigating how light reflecting off objects into the eye enables perception.

topics.title: Digitized Information and Morse Code
topics.description: Designing binary and digitized pulse codes to transmit patterns of information reliably.

modules.title: Earth's Changing Surface, Rock Layers & Fossils
modules.description: Interpreting rock layers and fossils to deduce past environments, analyzing topographic maps, and reducing hazard damage.

topics.title: Rock Formations and Fossil Records
topics.description: Examining rock layer sequences to reconstruct changes in landscape over geological time.

topics.title: Weathering, Erosion and Deposition
topics.description: Investigating the effects of water, ice, wind, and vegetation on landscape erosion.

topics.title: Plate Tectonics & Natural Hazard Engineering
topics.description: Mapping earthquake zones, tsunamis, and volcanic belts, and designing seismic-resistant structures.
